title: How to Write a Free Verse Poem
skills: compose an original free verse poem
develop poetic voice without relying on fixed meter or rhyme

alignment_note: Provides practical guidance for composing free verse poetry using purposeful line breaks, imagery, rhythm, and voice without requiring a fixed rhyme scheme or meter. Supports poetry composition, revision, structural choices, and development of individual poetic style across high school English courses.
